record.title: Uzbekistan restricts Afghanistan passenger land crossing
record.direction: Passenger entry and travel through the crossing
record.movement: Private passengers, including Afghans seeking refuge
record.exceptions: Freight, authorized cases and later Airitom free-trade-zone visits; December 2021 operational reporting also noted possible non-Afghan passenger access.
record.enforcement: MFA confirms closure in August 2021; AFP obtained Chamber confirmation of resumption on 23 November 2025.
record.official_rationale: June 2021 suspension expressly cited worsening coronavirus infection in Afghanistan; August 2021 MFA statement cited security and rejected Afghan refugee admission. These are separately attributed phases.
record.context: Taliban advance and takeover overlapped COVID controls.
record.uncertainty: June versus August 2021 may describe different phases. Operational reporting separately dates later complete inward restriction from October 29 and outward restriction from November 7, 2021 and notes possible non-Afghan passage. The timed phase is limited to ordinary Afghan entry into Uzbekistan. November 23, 2025 is the Chamber-confirmed resumption; third-country eligibility remains outside that claim.
